text: The real session appears in ready within 5s of muse's TUI finishing launch (2-14 precedent: verified to precede its own proc-<PID> presession shadow).
muse-bin PID bound to the real session via its .session.lock held flock fd.
The prompt drives ready -> working ("force ready→working on first activity"), per 2-14's live-confirmed shape post commit 9abf13d1.

The induced model-call failure drives working -> error via the session_error classifier rule (SessionError set on terminal:"failed", session_error_class either a captured error_class or the terminal_failed fallback). Sticky: no reversion to ready/waiting for the rest of the session's life.
